probe_summary.evidence_goal: Whether the target object is acquired in fewer navigation steps than a strict listed-order traversal or a generic surface-first heuristic, without visiting any implausible fixture.
probe_summary.local_function: Systematically visit and open listed receptacles until the target object is found, then take it into inventory.
probe_summary.realization_pattern: Navigate to a semantically plausible surface or storage receptacle; open if required; inspect contents; acquire target if present; otherwise continue to the next plausible receptacle, explicitly skipping implausible fixture types.
stop_conditions: Target object is successfully taken into inventory
All semantically plausible receptacles have been visited and inspected without finding the target
An action fails or returns an unexpected error
